description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and exception info, and displays them in the UI.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages. Implements LogNode to receive log data and chain log handlers.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, optionally including exception information, and updates the UI thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string and delimiter to a StringBuilder if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
